fun ListNode.swapPairs(): ListNode {
    var first: ListNode? = this
    var second = first?.next
    var third = second?.next
    var fourth = third?.next
    val head = second ?: return first!!

    second.next = first
    first?.next = fourth ?: third

    do {
        first = third
        second = first?.next
        third  = second?.next
        fourth = third?.next

        second?.next = first
        first?.next = fourth ?: third
    } while (third != null)

    return head
};0

fun IntGrid.getOutgoing(node: Node): Collection<Edge<Node, Unit?>> {
    val edges = ArrayList<Edge<Node, Unit?>>(3)
    for (i in 0..3) {
        val dir = Direction(i)
        if (dir == -node.dir) continue
        if (node.dirCount >= 3 && dir == node.dir) continue
        val posX = node.posX + dir.x
        val posY = node.posY + dir.y
        if (!contains(posX, posY)) continue
        val loss = this[posX, posY]
        edges.add(Edge(node, Node(posX, posY, dir, if (dir == node.dir) node.dirCount + 1 else 1), loss, Unit))
    }
    return edges
};0

fun canFormByteland(n: Int, castles: List<Pair<Pair<Int, Int>, Pair<Int, Int>>>): String {
    val aList = mutableListOf<Int>()
    val bList = mutableListOf<Int>()
    val cList = mutableListOf<Int>()
    val dList = mutableListOf<Int>()
    var sumArea: Long = 0L
    for (castle in castles) {
        val (ll, ur) = castle
        val (a, b) = ll
        val (c, d) = ur
        aList.add(a)
        bList.add(b)
        cList.add(c)
        dList.add(d)
        sumArea += (c - a).toLong() * (d - b)
    }
    val xMin = aList.minOrNull() ?: 0
    val xMax = cList.maxOrNull() ?: 0
    val yMin = bList.minOrNull() ?: 0
    val yMax = dList.maxOrNull() ?: 0
    val minimalArea = (xMax - xMin).toLong() * (yMax - yMin)
    return if (sumArea == minimalArea) "YES" else "NO"
};1

fun generateFactorials(n: Int): List<Long> {
    /**
     * Return a list with the factorials from 0! up to (n-1)!.
     *
     * Parameters
     * ----------
     * n : Int
     *     Number of consecutive factorials to generate.
     *
     * Returns
     * -------
     * List<Long>
     *     A list of length `n` where the i-th element is i!.
     *     If n <= 0, an empty list is returned.
     */
    if (n <= 0) {
        return emptyList()
    }

    val factorials = mutableListOf<Long>()
    factorials.add(1L) // 0! is 1
    var current = 1L   // running product for the next factorial

    for (k in 1 until n) {
        current *= k
        factorials.add(current)
    }
    return factorials
};1

fun file_size_distribution(directory: String) {
    val n = 9
    val sizes = arrayOf(0, 1000, 10000, 100000, 1000000, 10000000, 100000000, 1000000000, 10000000000)
    val count = IntArray(n + 1)
    var files = 0
    var total_size = 0L
    val iter = File(directory).walk()
    for (dir_entry in iter) {
        if (dir_entry.isFile &&!dir_entry.isSymbolicLink) {
            val file_size = dir_entry.length()
            total_size += file_size
            var i = 0
            while (i < sizes.size && sizes[i] < file_size) {
                i++
            }
            val index = i
            count[index]++
            files++
        }
    }
    println("File size distribution for $directory:")
    for (i in 0..n) {
        if (i == n) {
            print("> ${sizes[i - 1]}")
        } else {
            print("%16d".format(sizes[i]))
        }
        println(" bytes: ${count[i]}")
    }
    println("Number of files: $files")
    println("Total file size: $total_size bytes")
}

    Simulate a 1-dimensional random walk of a particle that starts at 0
    and, at each of the given `time` steps, moves either +1 or –1 with
    equal probability.

    Parameters
    ----------
    time : Int
        Number of time steps (must be >= 0).  If a negative number is
